decision_needed.question: The Student Fees fund spent 4,115 ('Extracurricular activity fees') and the General Fund received exactly 4,115 labelled 'Transfers' within nonrevenue receipts. Should this be a transfer rather than spending/receipts?
decision_needed.recorded_as: Top-level statement lines kept as printed (inside Other receipts 18,752 and the Other Governmental Funds part of Student support services, recorded as student activities); in detail both sides are other financing (General Fund +4,115, Student Fees -4,115, with the Student Fees expenditure total marked includes other financing)

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts, disbursements and changes in fund balances statement (p3); beginning/ending balances (3,230,258 / 4,079,849) from p4, equal to net position on p1-2. Transfers 165,000 in/out between General Fund and other funds net to zero in the total column; shown as transfers_in/out (p4) and not included in the printed totals. Other local receipts 17,995 split using the General Fund budget schedule (rental 16,850 + distance education 1,054 = charges; other local revenue 91 = other). Printed 'Other' receipts 18,752 is a mix (GF nonrevenue 15,880 incl. 4,115 transfer, 2,523 non-program, plus 349 nutrition non-program). Debt services not split between principal and interest. Balance sheet from the Statement of Activities and Net Position, net position section (p2); no liabilities. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp7-10) rather than the combining schedule (pp5-6), which would double count; Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns in the combining schedule are covered by their own fund schedules (pp11-12). Hidden transfer: General Fund 'Non program' 247,654 includes 240,931 transfer to Depreciation Fund (eliminated in reclassification column, p6), recorded as other financing -240,931 with remainder 6,723 as expenditure; Depreciation 'General Fund support' 240,931 recorded as other financing +. GF Federal programs and State categorical programs assigned to instruction per reclassification column on p6. Budget amounts for Federal programs (135,000 group total) not assigned to lines. Lines with blank 2025 actual (e.g., Local fines and licenses, Career education, Employee Benefit disbursements) omitted. Read pages 1-16 of 16. Student support services 409,593 split by the statement's own fund columns (p3): General Fund 194,450 as support services, Other Governmental Funds 215,143 (Activities 211,028 + Student Fees 4,115, pp15-16) as student activities.
